canonical_record_present.meaning: Supplied canonical snapshot contains the expected identity.

dataset_binding_present.meaning: Selected dataset contains an object at the record's declared binding key; not evidence qualification.

declared_anatomical_references_resolved.meaning: At least one declared reference resolves, all declarations resolve and no parent cycle involves this identity; not articulation qualification.

declared_dimensions_complete.meaning: Nonempty declared dimensions are all finite, positive numbers; not dimensional fidelity.

dimensional_primitive_available.meaning: Canonical geometry has dimensional_estimate status; not an anatomical surface.

individual_display_identity.meaning: Individual provisional proxy, excluding hardware and grouped forms.

record_validation_pass.meaning: Existing ValidatorAgent reports no per-record blocker; independent of whole-model and physical release gates.

reference_declaration_present.meaning: Record declares at least one nonempty reference string; citations are not verified.

source_module_present.meaning: Local module declares the expected identity; not evidence of measured data.
